summary: 5 HIGH and 7 MEDIUM findings block approval. Critical issues: missing allocated_amount field for per-application disbursement tracking (user requirement from message 4), ambiguous error logging, unverified Chart.js integration path, schema compatibility gaps, illogical constituency breakdown access control, timezone discrepancies in deadline enforcement, disconnected frontend-backend filter implementation, missing input validation, and HTML injection risks in email templates.
mustFix: Add Application.allocated_amount field with migration and update reports calculations
Specify explicit error logging format to prevent credential exposure
Verify index.html location or switch to npm-based Chart.js import
Verify ApplicationOut schema matches application_out() return structure
Fix constituency_breakdown endpoint access control for reviewers
Resolve timezone handling for deadline enforcement consistency
Connect frontend filter state changes to backend API calls with query params
Add case-insensitive collation for constituency/name sorting
Return 400 errors for invalid date formats instead of silent ignore
Add URL query param persistence to BursariesPage filters
Add HTML escaping to email template user inputs
Filter inactive users from reviewer notification query
recommendedOrder: HIGH #1 - allocated_amount field (blocks reports accuracy and user requirement)
MEDIUM #6 - timezone handling (prevents application rejection bugs)
MEDIUM findings in order of impact
